name: DFW 2021 IECC, Dallas and Arlington
description: Two-story slab house permitted under the 2021 IECC with NCTCOG amendments: Dallas from May 12, 2023 and Arlington from January 1, 2023. A post-2020 house elsewhere in DFW (Fort Worth and most suburbs) was likely built to the 2015 code; use the 2016 to 2020 template. Inspect and override.

era.code_basis: 2021 IECC with NCTCOG amendments, adopted by Dallas (Chapter 59, May 12, 2023) and Arlington (January 1, 2023); the Texas statewide code stays the 2015 IRC.

sources.citation: RhoeFlow DFW era template research (claude/01-plan/dfw-era-template-research.md), section Era by era: 2021 on. Every value, its range, evidence type and confidence.
2021 IECC Chapter 4, climate zone 3: U 0.30, SHGC 0.25, ceiling R-49, wall R-20 or 13+5ci; 3 ACH50 prescriptive, 5 maximum; ducts R-8; total duct leakage 4 cfm25 per 100 ft2
NCTCOG regional amendments to the 2021 IECC, climate zone 3: U 0.32, ceiling R-42, slab R-0; every house blower-door tested
City of Dallas Chapter 59, Dallas Energy Conservation Code (2021 IECC as amended), effective May 12, 2023

ceiling_insulation_cavity_r.basis: Code as amended by NCTCOG and Dallas: R-42 (base 2021 IECC is R-49). Medium confidence; the amendment text is hard to read.

wall_insulation_cavity_r.basis: Code: R-20 cavity, or R-13 plus continuous insulation (NCTCOG appears to allow R-13 plus R-3).

air_leakage.basis: Code 3 ACH50 on the prescriptive path, 5 on any path; every house tested under the NCTCOG amendments, so ask for the test report.

duct_insulation_r.basis: Code R-8 for ducts outside conditioned space, 3 in. and up.

duct_leakage_to_outside.basis: Code total leakage limit 4 cfm25 per 100 ft2, which caps leakage to outside. A duct-blaster result replaces this.

roof_radiant_barrier.basis: Assumption: no prevalence data was found. Confirm from the attic photo.
